title: Saint-Thégonnec Stirling Memorial
memorial_details: Memorial stone and plaque in Saint-Thégonnec-Loc-Eguiner, Finistère.
narrative: Stirling R9248 of 75 (New Zealand) Squadron, coded AA-H, departed Newmarket Heath at 1746 on 23 January 1943 for Lorient. The aircraft was severely damaged by Flak and the pilot attempted a crash-landing at Saint-Thégonnec. Six crew were killed; one evaded capture.
cause_of_loss: Severely damaged by Flak; forced crash-landing at Saint-Thégonnec

sources.title: Chorley, W.R. — Bomber Command Losses Vol. 4
Tony Hibberd (RAF Bomber Command Memorials Facebook group, admin post)
